snippet.title: Contra Spem Spero — Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Contra Spem Spero (Latin for 'Against all hope, I hope') is a narrative-driven horror experience that blends text-based exploration, immersive visual novel storytelling, survival elements, and puzzle-solving. Not every road leads out. You are lost deep in a twisted place — a forest one can only hope to escape.

Wishlist on Steam! ✦ https://store.steampowered.com/app/3294020/Contra_Spem_Spero/

Full release planned for summer 2025! Follow us for the latest updates and exclusive sneak peeks.

• Discord Server - https://discord.gg/aDYgYq2YN9
